title: docs(plugin-detail): README describes the count-first related tabs and the width layout as they are
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XS45uS4YmpkyKDUwCT41Tq)_
Fixes #36493

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：只改记录详情插件随包发布的说明文档里描述记录页的三处文字，界面和行为都不变；下个版本的更新记录会多一行说明。
- 属于「记录页对标 Attio」专题的收尾：上一次改版留下几处旧文字，还在讲已经去掉的右侧摘要卡片和按宽度分档。
- 只有照说明文档接入记录页的开发者会碰到；出错最多是文档里仍有一句不准，可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

Docs only: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/README.md` (sections "One record page, laid out by its width" and "Reference Rail on an authored page") plus a `patch` changeset, since `README.md` is in the package's `files[]` and so ships. No code, no test. Every sentence below was checked against the plugin-detail source on `origin/main` at 84853fd1 (and unchanged by the main merged in at 41d9c852).

**The related-panels paragraph (was: "load counts first and rows on demand (`RelatedCardStack`)")**

- `RelatedCardStack` no longer exists: no component, export or file of that name in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src`; the name survives only in code comments (see Acceptance notes). The sentence naming it is gone.
- "each panel is a placeholder ... reads its first three rows ... once it is in view (`IntersectionObserver`)" described the compact card face (`RelatedListCompactContext`, `COMPACT_RELATED_ROWS`, `useSeenOnce` in `relatedListCompact.ts`). Nothing outside tests provides `RelatedListCompactContext` as true, and `RecordPageColumns` draws no panels, so those sentences are removed.
- New text, each clause against its source:
  - "Every related list the page places, the ones the reader hid included, is counted in one request set when the record opens": `RecordPageColumns` builds `countTargets` from `resolved.order` and `resolved.hidden` and passes them to `useRelatedCounts` (whose header: ONE request set per parent, one `Promise.all`).
  - "a tab shows no number while its count is unknown, and a count of 0 mutes the tab's label": `RecordTab.count` doc in `RecordTabRow.tsx` (absent or `null`: no chip; `0` draws no number, the label is muted) and `hasCount` / `isEmptyRecordTab`; `panelTab` passes `countOf(id)`, which is `null` unless the state is `counted`.
  - "A write to a child list counts it again": `useRelatedCounts` doc (the data-change bus invalidates `RelatedCountStore`, the hook re-counts).
  - "A related list reads its rows only when its tab is open (on a pinned page the first tab of the row is open from the start), and then draws the full list": the face is drawn only for `openTab` (`enlargedRelatedList(node)`); `impliedTab` is `otherTabs[0]` when pinned and nothing is addressed.
  - "The details never wait for the counts", `relatedFieldsOf`, `prefetchRelatedCounts`, `relatedCountTargetsIn`: kept, re-checked against `RecordPageColumnsProps.relatedFieldsOf`, `countTargets` in `useRelatedCounts.ts` (a held field container skips the schema read), and `PrefetchUpcomingRelatedCounts` in app-shell `recordDrawerStack.tsx` (warms the drawer's upcoming records). "the record `↑` / `↓` would show next" now reads "the records", since it warms each upcoming record.

**The tiers text**

- "One header ... serves every tier" now "every layout", and "A slotted page keeps the synthesized strip, so it takes the tiers" now "takes the layout above": `RecordPageColumns` decides pinned or not from `useContentWidth` plus `recordPagePinsDetails(contentWidth, columns, fullPage)`; the `tier` prop is only stamped as `data-record-page-tier`, as the section's earlier paragraph (kept) already says.
- The earlier tier paragraph ("No width draws a right column ... `tier` (`recordPageTierFor`) is still taken and stamped ...") was re-checked and left as is: `recordPageTierFor` and `useRecordPageTier` still exist and are exported, `rightColumn` / `rail` are deprecated and ignored in `RecordPageColumnsProps`.

**The host example**

- "A host wires it with three exports" now "four": the import line names `RecordPageColumns`, `buildDefaultPageColumns`, `buildDefaultPageSchema` and `useRecordPageTier`, all exported from `src/index.tsx`.
- The comment "its width picks the tier" now "measured for the tier"; the `null` gate comment is kept (it is what `useRecordPageTier` documents).
- The example passes `fullPage`, with a two-line comment: without it `recordPagePinsDetails` never pins, so a full-page host copying the old example lost the pinned layout. `fullPage` is a declared optional prop of `RecordPageColumnsProps`, the console passes it as `fullPage={!embedded}`.

**The Reference Rail section (patch round, surface widened on #36493)**

- "The synthesized default page never emits it: its right column already shows every related list as a compact panel" now reads "... never emits it: each related list it places is a tab of its own on the record's tab row, with its count". There is no right column at any width (`RecordPageColumns` doc, `recordPagePinsDetails`), and the synthesizer gives each related list a tab whose `value` is `related:OBJECT.FIELD` (`buildDefaultTabs` in `synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`), counted as described above.
- The rest of the section was re-checked and kept: `record:reference_rail` is registered (`ComponentRegistry.register('reference_rail', ...)` in `src/index.tsx`); the removed options (`showReferenceRail`, `hideReferenceRail`, `hideRelatedTab`, the `slots.rightRail` slot) are listed as gone in `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`, and the synthesized page has one region, `main`.

**Changeset**

- `.changeset/36493-plugin-detail-readme-layout.md`: `'@object-ui/plugin-detail': patch`, one line, with line-initial `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. The `skip-changeset` label is removed (claim amendment on #36493).

`content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx` repeats neither paragraph (no `RelatedCardStack`, no tier text, no compact-panel text), so it is unchanged.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/README.md`, the related-tabs paragraph: the claim that rows are read only for the open tab.
2. `.changeset/36493-plugin-detail-readme-layout.md`: the package name and the two declaration lines.
3. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx`, the `countTargets` / `useRelatedCounts` block and the `openTab` / `impliedTab` lines it describes.

## Tests

None: the diff is one README and one changeset. Gates below.

## Acceptance notes

- Stale code comments, not touched (no code edits on this card): `useRelatedCounts.ts` header ("the related column's compact cards read it today"), `relatedListCompact.ts` (`RelatedListCompactContext` "Set by `RecordPageColumns` only"), and two app-shell `RecordDetailView.tsx` comments naming `RelatedCardStack`.
- Observation, read-only and not measured: the compact card path (`RelatedListCompactContext`, `useSeenOnce`, the `RelatedCountStore.takeRows` adoption in `RelatedList`) is provided true only in tests, while the console's record-page request still asks `top: COMPACT_RELATED_ROWS` rows per related list (`recordPagePayload.ts`). Whether those rows are now read for nothing was not measured.
- The mdx page's "Console Integration" mentions the 动态 panel's five entries; not one of the two paragraphs, not re-measured.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `grep -n 'RelatedCardStack\|three rows\|takes the tiers\|compact panel' ui/packages/plugin-detail/README.md` prints nothing; `grep -n 'fullPage' ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx` shows the prop the example now passes.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 30 commands for the two changed paths (the 19 of the first round plus 11 the changeset brings: `check-adr-0087-registration` (+ `--self-test`), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset` (+ `--self-test`), `snapshot-next --self-test`, `check-governed-queue-guard --self-test`, `release-rehearsal-clone --self-test`, `release-pending-publish --self-test`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`). `--ran`: "30 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 30 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". The first round's 19 were green on a9edb486 and on 41d9c852.
`overlap-check --branch=HEAD`: VERDICT clean exit 0.
